item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting that fills the entire image edge to edge. Explore the tension between gathering possibilities and arriving at clarity through paint alone. A dense, off-center accumulation of midnight violet, charcoal, and deep ultramarine is interrupted by thin, luminous seams of pale citron and electric coral. Build translucent veils over rough impasto, with scraped passages exposing earlier layers. Let short, restless brushstrokes gather into uneven rhythms, then dissolve into broad, quiet expanses of warm ivory. Keep the composition asymmetrical: compressed and turbulent toward the lower left, spacious but subtly charged toward the upper right. Include dry-brush friction, feathered pigment, abrupt opaque strokes, and edges that alternately sharpen and disappear. Allow a few gestures to stop unexpectedly, leaving tension unresolved. The painting should feel materially rich and spontaneous, with clarity emerging locally while other passages remain ambiguous. Every mark must remain abstract. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, gallery setting, border, or mockup. Show only the square painting."}
